title: Personal Credit Cards: redeeming rewards points and when points are forfeited
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: redemption and forfeiture of rewards points

This policy covers how rewards points on a Personal Credit Cards account are redeemed, how the USD value of a redemption is set, the account status redemption requires, and the events on which unredeemed points are forfeited. The smallest redemption, the point values and the list of redemption ways are the tier's own terms.

## Policy clauses in force

1. Points are redeemed only in whole points, at least the tier's smallest redemption per redemption, by one of the tier's redemption ways.
2. A statement credit or a gift card is valued at the tier's cash value per point; travel booked through the rewards center is valued at the tier's travel value per point.
3. The USD value of a redemption is the points multiplied by the applicable value per point, rounded half-up to the cent.
4. Redemption is allowed only while the account is active.
5. All unredeemed points are forfeited when the account reaches the tier's forfeiture threshold in days past due, when it is charged off, and when it closes; a cardholder closing the card must therefore redeem before the closure is confirmed.
6. Points never expire otherwise.

## Retired clause

The clause of this policy that listed "a deposit to a PCB checking or savings account of the same customer" among the redemption ways, valued at the cash value per point, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current deposit basis, which is stated together with the rules for cashing out the points of a card that is being closed. The tier values themselves, including the cash value per point, remain valid.

## Redemption status check

| Account status | Redemption |
|---|---|
| active | allowed |
| suspended, charged off or closed | not allowed |

The status is read from the bank's record of the card account.

## Forfeiture events

| Event | Points affected |
|---|---|
| account reaches the tier's forfeiture threshold in days past due | all unredeemed points |
| account charged off | all unredeemed points |
| account closes | all unredeemed points |
| any other passage of time | none; points never expire otherwise |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- With a value per point of 0.0175 USD, a redemption of 1001 points is worth 17.5175 USD, rounded half-up to 17.52 USD.
- With a smallest redemption of 1000 points, a balance of 999 points cannot make a redemption; 1000 points can.
- A redemption of 1500.5 points is not possible: redemptions are made in whole points.

superseded_clauses: a deposit to a PCB checking or savings account of the same customer
